name: Lotte Shopping Co., Ltd.
summary: Lotte Shopping Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, owns and manages department stores in South Korea. It also operates outlets, discount stores, electronics stores, supermarkets, e-commerce, and movie theaters. In addition, the company is involved in the TV home shopping, clothing manufacturing and sales, home appliance retail, and movie screening businesses; provision of building management service; real estate, new technology investment, financial, and film investment production activities.
